body: Since `length()` is `size() - 1` should the `+ 1` be removed here?

Hrm, no, I don't think so. I think the intention is to see if `cstr[i + 1]` below is safe to run. However, since it was using `size` instead of `length`, it was checking the `NULL` terminator by accident, like the other instances here where `size` was used instead of `length`. Both should work; I'm keeping the check because relying on a `NULL` terminator at the end may bite us later if we want to remove it (ala #84680).
Makes sense! Thank you for the explanation
